{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0021",
      "decision": "include",
      "question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.3", "5B.6", "5B.8", "5B.10"],
      "relevance": "Reports executed municipal infrastructure expansion and social-protection programs, particularly the universal food pension for older adults; refusal to implement the contributory Seguro Popular based on an asserted existing free municipal alternative; and a qualified fiscal finding that DF debt rose, though materially more slowly than under prior governments.",
      "adjacent_context": [],
      "exclusion_reason": null
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0022",
      "decision": "include",
      "question_ids": ["5B.2", "5B.5"],
      "relevance": "Identifies López Obrador's finance secretary and other close officials in recordings depicting gambling with large sums, negotiations over political favors, and receipt of substantial cash from businessman Carlos Ahumada. These are concrete allegations relevant to the integrity of economic appointments and enforcement against politically connected actors.",
      "adjacent_context": ["U0023 supplies the institutional and personal response to the alleged corruption."],
      "exclusion_reason": null
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0023",
      "decision": "include",
      "question_ids": ["5B.2", "5B.5", "5B.7"],
      "relevance": "Reports that the PRD severed ties with implicated officials, prosecutors brought fraud and money-laundering charges and issued arrest and pretrial-detention orders, and López Obrador rejected the corruption only belatedly and weakly while emphasizing an alleged political conspiracy. It also records the author's qualification that it was difficult to imagine he was unaware of dealings involving his former close aide Bejarano.",
      "adjacent_context": ["U0022 identifies the implicated officials and describes the recorded conduct."],
      "exclusion_reason": null
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0024",
      "decision": "include",
      "question_ids": ["5B.4", "5B.6"],
      "relevance": "Describes a concrete property and infrastructure dispute: the DF government expropriated land to build access to a private hospital, a federal court ordered definitive suspension of the works, and the property company alleged that the government continued construction despite successive favorable judicial orders, ultimately prompting federal prosecutorial intervention.",
      "adjacent_context": ["U0026 describes the subsequent congressional removal of immunity and legal conflict but does not add an independent Chapter 5B economic finding."],
      "exclusion_reason": null
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0025",
      "decision": "include",
      "question_ids": ["5B.2", "5B.6"],
      "relevance": "Reports a concrete personnel decision: after President Fox removed DF public-security secretary Marcelo Ebrard over an omission-of-authority finding connected to a fatal lynching, López Obrador retained him in government by appointing him social-development secretary. This may bear on performance-based retention and administrative implementation capacity.",
      "adjacent_context": [],
      "exclusion_reason": null
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0026",
      "decision": "exclude",
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "The chunk concerns congressional removal of immunity, criminal procedure, demonstrations, and a constitutional dispute over whether López Obrador could remain in office.",
      "adjacent_context": ["U0024 contains the underlying land-expropriation, court-order, and infrastructure facts that independently bear on Chapter 5B."],
      "exclusion_reason": "It supplies political and procedural continuation of the desafuero dispute but no distinct economic policy action, outcome, cost, distributional result, implementation finding, economic appointment, or economic-governance enforcement fact."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0027",
      "decision": "exclude",
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "Reports resolution of the desafuero crisis, restoration of political rights, withdrawal of charges, López Obrador's departure to seek the presidency, and internal PRD succession and campaign debate.",
      "adjacent_context": [],
      "exclusion_reason": "The concrete actions concern criminal procedure, electoral eligibility, and party politics rather than economic governance under any Chapter 5B lens."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0028",
      "decision": "exclude",
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "Contains campaign positioning in favor of job-generating businesses and against corrupt officeholders, but no specified enacted policy, implementation, enforcement action, measured result, cost, or economic-governance method.",
      "adjacent_context": ["U0030 provides the subsequent concrete campaign proposals on fiscal enforcement, public expenditure, executive pay, and investigation of FOBAPROA."],
      "exclusion_reason": "The statements are generic campaign rhetoric and political biography rather than material evidence of a distinct Chapter 5B action or finding."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0029",
      "decision": "exclude",
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "Describes class- and regional-patterned electoral perceptions, polling, debate participation, and allegations against rival Felipe Calderón.",
      "adjacent_context": [],
      "exclusion_reason": "Electoral attitudes and campaign allegations about an opponent do not establish López Obrador's economic policy actions, implementation, outcomes, appointments, rules, or distributional incidence."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0030",
      "decision": "include",
      "question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.3", "5B.5", "5B.7", "5B.8"],
      "relevance": "Records concrete elements of López Obrador's 2006 economic platform: combating fiscal fraud and tax evasion, sharply reducing current expenditure, halving the president's salary, creating a Truth Commission to investigate FOBAPROA, and adopting a distributional priority framed as 'first the poor.' These are proposals rather than evidence of enactment or implementation.",
      "adjacent_context": ["U0028 supplies the campaign and coalition context but does not independently meet the material-evidence threshold."],
      "exclusion_reason": null
    }
  ]
}
